items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I never did come much in contact with Willie, but I knew he could play.

ctx.x: Surely. What did we say about Woodie? We didn't talk enough about Willie the Lion, I don't think.
Oh, Willie the Lion? Well, see, Willie the Lion was always like -- well, I never did come much in contact with Willie, but I knew he could play.
I had a couple clashes with him. He had a good ego, didn't he?

items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: The mention of Willie 'the Lion' Smith is a parenthetical note by the interviewer, not part of the interviewee's spoken narrative or response.

ctx.x: Duke used to go down there too.
Oh, yeah, Duke was down there. J.P. Johnson, would play a number 32 choruses and not one chorus the same.
